# WAS_bias_correction { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction }

```python
WAS_bias_correction()
```

Bias correction methods for continuous climate variables (e.g. temperature,
wind speed).

Supports mean adjustment, variance scaling, empirical quantile mapping and
parametric distribution mapping. Inputs may include negative values; for
strictly positive skewed data such as wind speed, use ``'lognormal'``,
``'gamma'`` or ``'weibull'`` distributions.

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- NaNs in observed / modeled data are filtered out at fit time. NaNs in
  ``doBC`` input propagate to NaNs in the output.
- Grid cells with fewer than 2 valid points in obs or mod are flagged
  (``all_nan``) and yield NaN output during application.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [doBC](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doBC) | Apply the fitted bias correction to new data. |
| [doDist](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doDist) | Apply parametric distribution bias correction. |
| [doMean](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doMean) | Apply mean additive bias correction. |
| [doQuant](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doQuant) | Apply empirical quantile mapping correction. |
| [doVarscale](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doVarscale) | Apply variance scaling bias correction. |
| [fitBC](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitBC) | Fit a bias correction model using the specified method. |
| [fitDist](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitDist) | Fit parametric bias correction assuming a specified distribution. |
| [fitMean](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitMean) | Fit mean additive bias correction. |
| [fitQuant](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitQuant) | Fit empirical quantile mapping (non-parametric). |
| [fitVarscale](#wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitVarscale) | Fit variance scaling bias correction. |

### doBC { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doBC }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.doBC(x, fobj, **kwargs)
```

Apply the fitted bias correction to new data.

### doDist { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doDist }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.doDist(x, fobj)
```

Apply parametric distribution bias correction.

### doMean { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doMean }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.doMean(x, fobj)
```

Apply mean additive bias correction.

### doQuant { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doQuant }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.doQuant(x, fobj, type='linear')
```

Apply empirical quantile mapping correction.

### doVarscale { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.doVarscale }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.doVarscale(x, fobj)
```

Apply variance scaling bias correction.

### fitBC { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitBC }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.fitBC(obs, mod, method, **kwargs)
```

Fit a bias correction model using the specified method.

### fitDist { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitDist }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.fitDist(obs, mod, distr='normal')
```

Fit parametric bias correction assuming a specified distribution.

### fitMean { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitMean }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.fitMean(obs, mod)
```

Fit mean additive bias correction.

### fitQuant { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitQuant }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.fitQuant(obs, mod, qstep=0.01, nboot=1)
```

Fit empirical quantile mapping (non-parametric).

### fitVarscale { #wass2s.WAS_bias_correction.fitVarscale }

```python
WAS_bias_correction.fitVarscale(obs, mod, std_tol=1e-06)
```

Fit variance scaling bias correction.

If the modeled std is below ``std_tol`` the cell is flagged as
``all_nan`` rather than silently substituting ``std_m = 1.0``; that
used to hide the underlying degeneracy.
